newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan c.bank injects 470 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan c.bank injects 470 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 470 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Wednesday.

The bank received bids totalling 4.482 billion dirhams and allocated 3.770 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 3.300 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 84.11 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on March 12, 1997.
